string.text: Wear-resistant auger
Reworked internal auger mechanism of the magazine with the addition of wear-resistant part improves its reliability and decreases the probability of malfunction.
Improved follower
Improved follower decreases the probability of feeding issues.
More durable parts
Increases the reliability of the gun by replacing weapon parts with their strengthened counterparts.
Picatinny rails
Picatinny rails allow to install various tactical attachments.
Lightweight handguard
maintenance handguard decreases overall weight of the weapon.
Laser sight

Provides a visual point of reference, visually marks the expected point of impact, facilitates and speeds up aiming, and has a demoralizing effect on the enemy. Does not interfere with the tactical flashlight and can be installed along with it.
Tactical flashlight
Long-range narrow beam flashlight is essential for night raids, as well as to seach and clear poorly lit rooms. Does not interfere with the laser sight and can be installed along with it.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Anatomical pistol grip
Custom-made pistol grip provides better grip for the right hand.
Recoil pad
Recoil pad from GP-25 accessories' kit dampens felt recoil.
Faster twist rate
Increases muzzle velocity, thus increasing the flatness of the trajectory. Useful for long range fire.
Barrel adjustment
Decreases bullet spread, which improves accuracy.
Rechamber for 9x19mm

Rechambering the gun for a more powerful 9x19mm cartridge. It should be noted, that all the parts installed in the process are original from the factory, made for less common variants of the "Bizon" (don't even ask how they are making their way into the Zone). The result meets the factory requirements and lacks any drawbacks typical for amatuer recalibrations. Since it has to accomodate a longer 9x19mm cartridge, the magazine capacity is effectively reduced to 53 rounds.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improves accuracy while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Improved ejector
Improved ejector decreases the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm.
Balanced bolt
Balanced bolt carrier group reduces muzzle climb.
Improved recoil spring
Forces the bolt carrier to faster go back into battery, thus increasing the rate of fire.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts.
